# @rxova/codemod

> jscodeshift codemods for migrating an existing codebase onto the Rxova input
> suite. One CLI, one transform per migration. This is the executable path for a
> migration — prefer it over rewriting call sites by hand.

## Use

    # list available transforms
    npx @rxova/codemod --help

    # preview without writing
    npx @rxova/codemod input-otp-to-otp --dry ./src

    # apply
    npx @rxova/codemod input-otp-to-otp ./src

Parses `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx`. Node `>= 20.19`. `--extensions=css,tsx,ts`
widens the file set, which is only meaningful for a transform that rewrites text
without parsing — `rx-token-prefixes` is the one that does.

## Transforms

### `input-otp-to-otp`

Migrates [`input-otp`](https://github.com/guilhermerodz/input-otp) to
`@rxova/react-otp-input`.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| `import { OTPInput } from 'input-otp'` | `import { OtpInput } from '@rxova/react-otp-input'` |
| `OTPInputProps` | `OtpInputProps` |
| `SlotProps` | `OtpSlotState` |
| `<OTPInput maxLength={6}>` | `<OtpInput length={6}>` |
| `containerClassName` | `className` |
| `slot.placeholderChar` | `slot.placeholder` |
| `pushPasswordManagerStrategy`, `textAlign`, `noScriptCSSFallback` | removed — there is no width hack to configure |

`value`, `onChange`, `pattern` and other compatible props are left untouched.

### `rx-token-prefixes`

Renames the styling hooks that moved into per-component namespaces in
`@rxova/react-otp-input` 1.0 and `@rxova/react-rating-input` 1.0.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| `--otp-*` | `--rx-otp-*` |
| `data-otp-*` | `data-rx-otp-*` |
| `--rfs-*` | `--rx-rating-*` |
| `data-rfs-*` | `data-rx-rating-*` |

    npx @rxova/codemod rx-token-prefixes --extensions css,scss,tsx,ts,jsx,js ./src

Include the stylesheets: that is where most of these names live, and this
transform rewrites text without parsing, so it reads a `.css` file that a normal
codemod could not. The state hooks — `data-invalid`, `data-disabled`,
`data-readonly`, `data-state`, `data-filled`, `data-active`, `data-fill`,
`data-idx` — did not move and are left alone. A second run is a no-op.

## Programmatic use

Each transform is exported for `jscodeshift -t` directly:

    npx jscodeshift -t node_modules/@rxova/codemod/dist/transforms/input-otp-to-otp.cjs --parser tsx ./src

## Three mistakes to avoid

1. **Assuming the run is complete.** Imports without a direct equivalent (e.g.
   `REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS`) are deliberately left importing from `input-otp` with a
   `TODO` comment, so the file still resolves. Grep for those afterwards — a green
   build does not mean the migration finished.
2. **Expecting the `render` prop to be converted.** It is preserved, not
   rewritten: the per-slot shape is compatible, so it keeps working. Turning it
   into the compound `<OtpGroup>` / `<OtpSlot>` API cannot be done reliably by an
   AST transform and stays a manual step.
3. **Skipping `--dry` and the formatter.** Always review the diff first, and
   re-run your formatter after — jscodeshift reprints the nodes it touches.
